summary: Complete testing of Phone Uniqueness Protection feature for OEMLinker. Found and FIXED a critical bug where the modular auth route (/app/backend/app/routes/auth.py) was missing phone normalization and duplicate check logic. After fix, all 15 backend tests pass. Frontend phone validation works correctly on VendorProfile and BuyerProfile pages with real-time indicators.

critical.issue: FIXED - Modular auth.py was missing phone normalization, duplicate check, and phone/phone_normalized fields in user_doc. Registration was allowing duplicate phones.
critical.fix_applied: Added phone normalization import, duplicate check logic, and phone fields to user_doc and vendor_doc in /app/backend/app/routes/auth.py

issues: Phone field only appears after GSTIN verification for vendors - this is by design but limits testing without valid GSTIN

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: /app/backend/app/routes/auth.py register() was missing phone normalization and duplicate check - now added
phone_utils.py correctly normalizes phones to E.164 format (+91XXXXXXXXXX)
check-phone endpoint correctly detects duplicates across users and vendors collections
PhoneCheck.jsx hook implements 600ms debounce for real-time validation
PhoneStatusIndicator component shows checking/available/taken/invalid states with appropriate icons
VendorProfile.jsx and BuyerProfile.jsx correctly integrate usePhoneCheck hook with current_user_id exclusion
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phone uniqueness feature fully tested and working. Key fix was in /app/backend/app/routes/auth.py which was missing phone handling. The modular routes take precedence over legacy routes in server.py. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_phone_uniqueness.py covers check-phone endpoint, registration blocking, and normalization. Frontend components PhoneCheck.jsx, VendorProfile.jsx, BuyerProfile.jsx all working correctly.

features_tested.check_phone_existing_number_taken: PASS - Existing phone 9831379959 returns available:false with PHONE_TAKEN code
features_tested.register_duplicate_phone_blocked: PASS - Registration with duplicate phone returns 400
features_tested.register_unique_phone_allowed: PASS - Registration with unique phone succeeds
features_tested.vendor_profile_own_phone_allowed: PASS - Vendor can update with own phone
features_tested.frontend_vendor_profile_validation: PASS - Red border and error message shown for duplicate
features_tested.frontend_buyer_profile_validation: PASS - Red border and error message shown for duplicate

bug_fixed.description: Modular auth route missing phone uniqueness enforcement
bug_fixed.root_cause: The /app/backend/app/routes/auth.py register() function was not updated with phone normalization and duplicate check logic that was added to the legacy route in server.py
bug_fixed.fix: Added import for phone_utils, phone normalization, duplicate check against users and vendors collections, and phone/phone_normalized fields to user_doc and vendor_doc
